question: Where’s the closest museum lying along the route toward Factory Shoals Recreation Park, Covington, GA from Homewood Suites, Atlanta, GA?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry AS geom FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Homewood Suites%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Atlanta%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%GA%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT p.geometry AS geom FROM parks p JOIN regions r ON ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, r.geometry::geography) WHERE p.park_name ILIKE '%Factory Shoals Recreation Park%' AND r.region_name ILIKE '%Covington%' AND r.border_type = 'city' LIMIT 1 ), route_corridor AS ( SELECT ST_Buffer(ST_MakeLine(sp.geom, ep.geom)::geography, 1000)::geometry AS corridor_geom FROM start_point sp, end_point ep ) SELECT p.poi_name FROM pois p, start_point sp, route_corridor rc WHERE p.museum = 'yes' AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, rc.corridor_geom::geography) ORDER BY ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, sp.geom::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
